title: Multi-Use Polite Formulas: Tessék and Kérem

sections.content:
**Tessék** and **Kérem** are the versatile Swiss Army knives of Hungarian politeness:
- **Tessék!** = Here you go! (handing something over) / Yes, please? (answering customer or knock on door) / Pardon? (asking to repeat: *Tessék?*)
- **Kérem (szépen)** = You're welcome! / Please! / Here you are.
- **Parancsoljon!** = At your service! / Please, help yourself! (formal hospitality)

sections.title: Uses of 'Tessék' and 'Kérem'
rows: Here you go / Here it is.

items.spanish: —Köszönöm szépen a segítséget! —Kérem szépen, nagyon szívesen!
items.english: —Thank you very much for the help! —You're very welcome!
—Here you go, here is your coffee! —Thank you!
